name: cpi_breadth_above3
notes: Share of the CPI basket (weighted) with Y/Y inflation above 3%. Boc-tracker port (analyze.py 2026-05-11 vintage). Components kept = 59 (those with first_valid_index <= 1995-01-01, intersected with cpi_component_weights_canada.json). Weights renormalised over the kept set; original weight sum was 96.09 of 100. Monthly rows dropped when any kept component is missing its 12-mo prior observation (the all-valid mask). Historical reference: 1996-2019 averages are 26.72% (above3) and 40.93% (below1).
